aggregation.calibration: leave-one-train-pair-out softmax over mean native teacher-forced likelihood; uniform fallback when fewer than two train pairs

untouched_validation.selection: deterministic SHA-256 salt ARC2_NATIVE_LIKELIHOOD_RANKER_V2_UNTOUCHED; excludes all prior native ranker, TTT verifier, and frozen30 cohorts; committed before candidate generation

selection_protocol: Smoke checks implementation and changes in rank only. The precommitted calibrated method is used unchanged for the single untouched cohort. No test target, task-specific feature, or post-score rerun is permitted.
